# Nagarjuna Kamireddy

> Lead AI Architect with 22 years in enterprise data platforms (SAP BW, BPC, HANA) and production machine learning and generative AI systems (John Deere, Persistent Systems, Vertiv, Soham Global, GlaxoSmithKline UK). AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (SAP-C02) and NVIDIA-Certified Professional: Agentic AI (NCP-AAI).

## Open-Source Repositories

- [enterprise-erp-odata-mcp-server](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-erp-odata-mcp-server): OData v4 Model Context Protocol server with EDM schema validation, row-level BUKRS authorization, PII masking, and write-approval gates.
- [enterprise-helpdesk-rag-guardrails](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-helpdesk-rag-guardrails): Hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval assistant with RBAC filtering, calibrated low-confidence refusal, and citation checks.
- [aegis-runtime](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/aegis-runtime): Deny-by-default capability policy language, compensating sagas, compaction attribution, and signed audit logs for agent tool calls.
- [prism-gate](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/prism-gate): OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway with TCP-Vegas concurrency limits, tenant rate budgets, cost-aware cascades, and PSI/JSD drift checks.
- [vecta](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/vecta): Filtered HNSW, IVF-PQ, RaBitQ, and hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval engine with C++20 distance kernels.
- [syntara](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/syntara): Grammar-constrained decoding compiling JSON Schema and regular expressions into minimal byte DFAs and token masks.
- [company-os](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/company-os): Config-driven 7-agent operations runtime with Kanban board, live logs, and KPI tracking.
- [adaptive-ai-tutor](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/adaptive-ai-tutor): 12-agent GPT-4o learning platform with prerequisite DAGs, Socratic coaching, rubric grading, and Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (Next.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma).
- [llm-knowledge-base](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/llm-knowledge-base): Incremental Markdown wiki builder, SQLite FTS5 search, and cited Q&A service (FastAPI).
- [langgraph-newsroom](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/langgraph-newsroom): 3-stage LangGraph editorial workflow with human approval checkpoints, SQLite persistence, and bounded error recovery.
- [governed-member-services-agent](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/governed-member-services-agent): Multi-tenant member-services agent with policy enforcement, grounded citations, and a 40-case evaluation suite.
- [verispec-sdd](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/verispec-sdd): Executable SPEC.md state-machine verifier for reachability, deadlocks, and Tarjan SCC livelocks with property-test synthesis.
- [skillbench](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/skillbench): Static information-flow taint analyzer and C++20 Aho-Corasick scanner for agent SKILL.md archives and MCP manifests.
- [weavegraph](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/weavegraph): Dependency-aware git worktree scheduler with Tarjan SCC condensation and 3-way AST merge checks.
- [tracegit](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/tracegit): Content-addressed version control for agent execution traces with edit-distance diffing and regression bisection.
- [calibra](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/calibra): Paired bootstrap, exact McNemar, Bradley-Terry CI, 2PL IRT, temperature scaling, and MinHash-LSH contamination checks.
- [enterprise-ai-field-guides](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-ai-field-guides): 15 open-access PDF field guides and handbooks on Hybrid RAG, Clean-Core OData MCP, Agent Evaluation, and Guardrails.
